title: JAB YAAD SAKINA KO TERI AATI HAI BABA
body:
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar zinda'n ki deewaaro'n se Takrati hai Baba
Kaano se tapakta hai Lahu Shaano pa Mere
Zalim ki aziyat Mujhe tadpati hai Baba
<<MINI>>
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Marjaaungi Pyaasi na kabhi Maangungi paani
Asghar ki Mujhe Pyaas jo Yaad aati hai Baba
<<MINI>>
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Jabtak Tere Seene pe na Sojaay Sakina
Zinda'n me Use neend kahan aati hai Baba
<<MINI>>
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalte huwe khaimo'n ke nazaare hain Nazar me
Ye baat khayalo'n se kahan jaati hai Baba
<<MINI>>
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aate hain jab shimre sitamgar ke mazalim
Ye Nanhi Si Dukhtar Teri Ghabrati hai Baba
<<MINI>>
Jab Yaad Sakina ko Teri aati hai Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai kaun Mere Paas Jiyu'n Kiske sahare
Tanhaayi Meri mout bani jaati hai Baba
